note: Search Autocomplete adds typeahead suggestions via the config entity type autocompletion_configuration (config prefix search_autocomplete.autocompletion_configuration.*). Each entity maps a CSS selector to a suggestion source (a callback URI, or view_id::display_id) and tunes minChar/maxSuggestions/autoSubmit/autoRedirect/no-result & more-result labels/theme/editable/deletable. Three configs ship enabled: search_block (nodes callback), search_form_content (words callback), search_form_users (users callback). It also provides Views display/row/style plugins (AutocompletionCallback / CallbackFieldRow / CallbackSerializer) to build JSON suggestion endpoints. Permissions: 'administer search autocomplete', 'use search autocomplete'. Medium/hard cases read/create autocompletion_configuration entities, verified by loading them via drush. Verify scans by CSS selector so the agent may choose any config id.

evals.prompt: In the search_autocomplete module, what configuration entity type do you create to add typeahead suggestions to a field, and what two things does each one connect?
evals.expected_output: You create an 'autocompletion_configuration' config entity. Each one connects a target field (a CSS 'selector') to a suggestion 'source' (a callback URI or a view_id::display_id), plus behavior like minChar, maxSuggestions, autoSubmit, autoRedirect.

evals.prompt: Which autocompletion configurations does the search_autocomplete module ship with, enabled out of the box?
evals.expected_output: Three: search_block (source autocompletion_callbacks_nodes::nodes_autocompletion_callback), search_form_content (words callback), and search_form_users (users callback).

evals.prompt: Which permissions does the search_autocomplete module define?
evals.expected_output: 'administer search autocomplete' (admin UI at /admin/config/search/search_autocomplete and the add/edit/delete forms) and 'use search autocomplete' (use autocompletion on configured fields).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site an extra autocompletion configuration (id sa_probe) has been added with search_autocomplete. Inspect the live configuration and state the CSS selector of the field it autocompletes.
evals.expected_output: sa_probe targets selector #probe-field (minChar 4). Read with `drush cget search_autocomplete.autocompletion_configuration.sa_probe`.

evals.prompt: This site has an autocompletion configuration (id sa_users_probe) created with search_autocomplete. Inspect the live configuration and report the suggestion source it uses.
evals.expected_output: sa_users_probe uses source autocompletion_callbacks_users::users_autocompletion_callback (selector #edit-sa-users). Discoverable via `drush cget search_autocomplete.autocompletion_configuration.sa_users_probe source`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the search_autocomplete module to create a new, enabled autocompletion configuration that targets the field with CSS selector '#edit-keys', starts suggesting after 2 characters (minChar 2), and draws suggestions from the node/content callback (source autocompletion_callbacks_nodes::nodes_autocompletion_callback). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An autocompletion_configuration entity exists with selector '#edit-keys', status TRUE and minChar 2 (any machine id).

evals.prompt: I want type-ahead suggestions to appear on my site's search box, which is the input with the CSS id 'site-search' (selector #site-search). Set this up with the search_autocomplete module and make it live.
evals.expected_output: An enabled autocompletion_configuration entity exists with selector '#site-search' (any machine id, any valid suggestion source).
